items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wasn't that old when I first heard uh Mr. Wonder... I found it very attractive... I found myself recording uh a number of his pieces

ctx.x: But yet you, your ear is drawn

Yeah. Well, uh, I wasn't that old when I first heard uh Mr. Wonder. I was in my 40s or 50s, and uh, I found it very attractive, these pieces. And uh, Songs in the Key of Life, you know, I mean, that's a double LP. And of out of all those songs, I picked that one.
